verdict.rationale: Floot publishes an official remote MCP server that Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients can connect to, and it runs on the user's own AI subscription rather than Floot credits. Through it, the external agent can build endpoints, tables and screens, read logs, query and migrate the database, create and restore checkpoints, and generate images, so the user's own agent can drive the builder instead of the built-in one. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), and explicit documentation of running an external agent alongside the built-in assistant on the same project.
